decisions.reason: After surviving its first year with a dedicated product page, this product looks like a validated option with enough traction to justify keeping it on the market while uncertainty continues to resolve.

As a 2024 launch with its own page, it is still an early-stage option and the firm is likely to keep it for another year because learning potential remains high relative to the cost of maintaining it.

Because it appears only as a website mention rather than a fully featured offering, it looks like a weaker and less committed option that an established German manufacturer would likely discontinue if early signals have not been convincing.
